svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: PCAL9555A: Typical application
svg.desc: Schematic of the PCAL9555A typical application: the chip with U2 MCU, R1 resistor 10 kΩ, R2 resistor 10 kΩ, R3 resistor 10 kΩ, C1 capacitor 100 nF, R4 resistor 2 kΩ, D1 led; the MCU wires carry the port hooks Write() / WriteRead().
svg.text: The expander on an MCU's I2C bus at address 0x20 (A2, A1 and A0 tied to VSS), with 10 kΩ pull-ups on SCL, SDA and INT to the 3.3 V supply and
an LED with its 2 kΩ resistor from VDD sunk by P0_0, as in the data sheet's typical application. The other port pins stay inputs. Above each MCU
wire: the port hook that drives it. Datasheet: 8 Application design-in information, p. 20.
* Not confirmed in the datasheet: C1 100 nF: the data sheet shows no decoupling capacitor; 100 nF at VDD is common practice.
